theorems.name: Submission.continuousLinearMap_det_contDiff_fderiv_eq_mul_trace
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun T : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n ↦ T.det) ∧ ∀ T H : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n, IsUnit T → fderiv ℝ (fun T : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn n ↦ T.det) T H = T.det * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (Ring.inverse T ∘L H).toLinearMap
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
